items.english: The edge is where two things meet — a fence line or the strip beside a path.
items.draft: Umphetho yindawo apho izinto ezimbini zidibana khona — umgca wocingo okanye umtya osecaleni kwendlela.
items.backtranslation: An edge is a place where two things meet: a wire fence line or a string beside a road.
items.problem: 'a strip beside a path' became 'umtya' (a string/rope beside the road), which is the wrong thing.
items.corrected: Umphetho yindawo apho izinto ezimbini zidibana khona — umgca wocingo okanye ucezu lomhlaba olusecaleni kwendlela.

items.english: These can be useful places to observe. Look at what already grows well along yours. That is the land telling you something.
items.draft: Ezi zinokuba ziindawo eziluncedo zokubukela. Jonga oko sele kukhula kakuhle ecaleni kweyakho. Umhlaba ngowo okuxelela into.
items.backtranslation: These can be useful places to watch. Look at what is already growing well next to yours. The land itself tells you something.
items.problem: 'along yours' became 'ecaleni kweyakho' with a concord that points to no noun, so the edge being referred to is lost.
items.corrected: Ezi zinokuba ziindawo eziluncedo zokubukela. Jonga oko sele kukhula kakuhle ecaleni komphetho wakho. Umhlaba ngowo okuxelela into.
